# Mermaid Tiny 12.3.0

Downloaded from the official npm package `@mermaid-js/tiny@12.3.0` on 2026-11-23. MIT licence; bundled third-party notices remain inside the unmodified script. Self-hosted here to keep diagram rendering browser-local and builds offline. Omits mindmap, architecture, KaTeX and ELK.
